title: Quantization Beyond Uniform Bit Allocation
abstract: arXiv:2608.19388v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Quantization is a fundamental technique to handle the growing sizes of embeddings generated by modern models. Existing quantization schemes are largely embedding agnostic and allocate bits uniformly across dimensions. However, recent models produce embeddings with significant geometric structure. In this work, we investigate whether a variable bit allocation scheme can improve quantization quality under a fixed memory budget. We propose a simple variable bit allocation framework that partitions an embedding into contiguous buckets and allocates storage non-uniformly across them. Using a greedy allocation strategy, we instantiate this framework for both Product Quantization (PQ) and Scalar Quantization (SQ). We perform a series of experiments on embeddings known to have the Matryoshka property (MRL), and consistently observe that non-uniform allocations outperform uniform baselines at identical storage budgets. translated_title: 超越均匀比特分配的量化方法
translated_abstract: 摘要：量化是处理现代模型生成的嵌入向量规模不断增长的基本技术。现有量化方案大多与嵌入内容无关，并在各维度上均匀分配比特。然而，近期模型生成的嵌入具有显著的几何结构。在本研究中，我们探讨在固定内存预算下，可变比特分配方案是否能提高量化质量。我们提出了一种简单的可变比特分配框架，该框架将嵌入划分为连续的桶，并在桶之间非均匀地分配存储空间。通过贪婪分配策略，我们将此框架应用于乘积量化（PQ）和标量量化（SQ）。我们在已知具有Matryoshka属性（MRL）的嵌入上进行了系列实验，并一致观察到，在相同存储预算下，非均匀分配优于均匀基线。最大改进发生在……
tldr: 本文提出一种可变比特分配量化框架，通过非均匀分配存储空间，在相同内存预算下显著提升量化质量，优于均匀分配基线。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a variable bit allocation quantization framework that non-uniformly allocates storage, consistently outperforming uniform baselines under the same memory budget and improving quantization quality.
